runtime_strategy: WSL2 Linux isolated scientific runtime managed with micromamba/conda, provider installations and protected manual workspaces
reference_strategy: Release-pinned managed downloads with local SHA-256, provider checksum where available, licence policy, schema validation and scientific review
release_policy: fail-closed until the actual runtime and reference are qualified
scientific_boundary: Software provisioning and qualification workflows can be 10/10. Provider licences, huge database downloads, hardware-specific execution and external scientific validation require operator actions and cannot be fabricated.
